component.name: Suborno
component.summary: Type Bangla naturally with a native phonetic input engine

description.p: Suborno is a native Bengali (Bangla) input method built with modern C++20. It provides phonetic composition (Suborno, Classic, Smart mapping families), the Probhat, Khipro and Bangladesh national keyboard layouts, Unicode-aware candidate ranking, spell correction and a SQLite-backed personal dictionary that learns from committed text.
The portable core exposes a C API, ships command-line tools for dictionary import and benchmarking, and integrates natively with the Windows Text Services Framework.
First packaging release: portable engine with phonetic, Probhat, Khipro and national layouts, candidate ranking, spell correction, personal dictionary, C API and Windows TSF integration.
